Rahul Gandhi receives Lok Sabha notice over remarks on Amit Shah

Rahul Gandhi has been issued a notice by the Lok Sabha Secretariat following remarks he made about Home Minister Amit Shah. The notice was sent by a committee of the Lok Sabha Secretariat, seeking a response from Gandhi regarding his statements. The specific nature of the remarks that led to the notice has not been detailed in the coverage.
